Table 3.2 "Effective Stress" Concentrations around Circular Holes in Flat Plates, Reinforced by Various Methods

issues: asset_note: Schematic showing rim (pipe collar) reinforcement geometry above and doubler (reinforcing pad) plus flat plate geometry below; labels include H, L, t_n, R, and flat plate. Caption appears beneath the diagrams.

asset_note: Table spans the lower-left of the page. Columns: H1/R, t/t_bar, t'/R, then Stress Intensification Factor sub-columns (Biaxial Tension, Uniaxial Tension, Average), then Area of Reinforcement / Area of Cut-out sub-columns (Rim, Doubler, Total). Three section headers separate the body: 'Rim Reinforcement only', 'Doubler Plate Reinforcement only', and 'Doubler and Rim Combined'. Em-dash entries in source rendered as empty cells.
